Andre Williams  
(555) 123-4567 | andre.williams@email.com | San Francisco, CA | linkedin.com/in/andre-williams  
https://github.com/andre-williams | https://www.linkedin.com/in/andre-williams  

A seasoned backend engineer with over a decade of experience in building scalable, secure systems for high-stakes cybersecurity environments. Specialized in designing resilient architectures that balance performance with compliance, while mentoring teams to adopt best practices in infrastructure automation and threat detection. Proven ability to lead cross-functional efforts that reduce operational risks and improve system reliability through proactive security integration.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Docker**: Spearheaded containerization of legacy monoliths at ThreatDetect Inc., reducing deployment latency by 40% and enabling seamless integration with Kubernetes for hybrid cloud environments.  
- **CI/CD pipelines**: Architectured a Jenkins-based pipeline at CyberShield Technologies that cut release cycles from weeks to hours, with 99.95% deployment success rates and zero production rollbacks over two years.  
- **Kubernetes**: Engineered a self-healing cluster for real-time threat analytics, scaling from 50 to 500 pods during peak traffic while maintaining sub-100ms latency for critical security workflows.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized query performance for a compliance database by 65% through index restructuring and partitioning, ensuring regulatory reporting met SLA requirements without downtime.  
- **Python**: Developed custom monitoring scripts that flagged anomalous behavior in network traffic, reducing false positives by 30% and improving incident response times by 25%.  
- **Redis**: Integrated in-memory caching for a high-volume API gateway, reducing database load by 70% and improving request throughput to 15k RPM during DDoS events.  
- **AWS**: Led the migration of ThreatDetect’s infrastructure to AWS, consolidating costs by 35% while enhancing security through VPC segmentation and IAM role-based access.  
- **Go**: Built core components of CyberShield’s threat detection engine, achieving 99.99% uptime with minimal GC overhead, and mentoring junior engineers in performance-critical code patterns.  
- **Microservices architecture**: Redesigned a monolithic security dashboard into microservices, enabling independent scaling of modules and reducing mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 50%.  
- **REST API design**: Standardized API contracts across CyberShield’s product suite, reducing integration errors by 45% and streamlining third-party vendor onboarding.  
- **Terraform**: Automated provisioning of 500+ infrastructure components across AWS and Azure, cutting manual setup time by 75% and ensuring compliance with SOC2 controls.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Staff Backend Engineer*  
CyberShield Technologies | 2020–Present  
Led the development of backend systems for real-time threat intelligence platforms, focusing on scalability and security. Designed a Kubernetes-based architecture that handles 10M+ events/day, integrating with SIEM tools for automated incident correlation. Spearheaded the adoption of CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment risks and enabled rapid iteration of security features. Mentored junior engineers in Go best practices and infrastructure-as-code principles, resulting in a 30% reduction in critical bugs in production.  

*Staff Backend Architect*  
CyberShield Technologies | 2016–2020  
Architected a microservices framework for cybersecurity analytics, decomposing a monolithic system into modular services with clear API boundaries. Implemented Redis-backed caching layers to handle peak traffic during security audits, ensuring sub-second response times for compliance reporting. Collaborated with security teams to embed encryption and access controls into the pipeline, reducing vulnerabilities in data transit by 80%.  

*Senior Backend Engineer*  
ThreatDetect Inc. | 2013–2016  
Built scalable backend systems for network traffic analysis tools, focusing on real-time data processing. Engineered a PostgreSQL-based database schema that supported 100k+ concurrent queries, optimized for compliance audits. Introduced Docker for containerized deployments, improving environment consistency across dev, staging, and production.  

*Junior Backend Developer*  
SecureVault Startups | 2010–2013  
Developed foundational backend services for encryption tools, gaining hands-on experience with Python and RESTful APIs. Contributed to the design of a CI/CD pipeline that streamlined deployment of security patches, reducing time-to-market for critical updates.  

**Projects**  
- **Security Monitoring Platform**: Developed a real-time analytics dashboard using Go and Redis, processing 500k+ events/sec with minimal latency.  
- **Compliance Database Optimization**: Restructured PostgreSQL schemas to meet regulatory reporting deadlines, achieving 99.9% query reliability.  
- **Hybrid Cloud Migration**: Led the transition of ThreatDetect’s infrastructure to AWS, integrating Kubernetes for workload orchestration.  
- **Threat Detection Engine**: Built core modules for a machine learning-based anomaly detection system, reducing false positives by 30% through rule refinement.
